waiver.label: Fee waiver: grounds, mandatory vs discretionary, purpose statement, written denial, appeal
waiver.value: mandatory no-charge: (a) certified copies + searches for claims/benefits presented to the United States (§ 39-122); (b) one copy of police report, audio and video recordings to qualifying crime victims/representatives (§ 39-127) | otherwise discretionary: public bodies 'are not required to impose a charge' but no hardship waiver is required | purpose statement: not required for waiver (non-commercial affirmation only) | written denial / appeal of a fee-waiver refusal: none
